items.body:
<details open>

ui: Llama UI design system: tokens, surfaces and fonts (#32468)

* ui: bring @ggml-org/llama-ui into ui/lib/ui

The design system package (tokens, fonts, surfaces, components and Model UI), so far in the temporary ggml-org/llama-ui
repository at edaf518, moves to its home in ui/lib/ui, built with @sveltejs/package and published as @ggml-org/llama-ui
from here. ui/lib holds the packages, one folder each. Its references to tools/ui now name ui/apps/chat, its
package.json points at this repository, and the UI workflow type-checks and packs it. ui/README.md describes the
layout.

Assisted-by: Claude (Opus 5.5 Medium)

* ui: Llama UI design system: tokens, surfaces and brand

The design system from allozaur/docs/storybook-overhaul: three tiers of
tokens, matte glass surfaces, Llama Sans and Llama Mono, and the base
components on the new tokens (Tabs and GlassKey among them). It also
restyles the stack's features with it, replacing the plain stand-ins they
used until now. DESIGN.md is generated from the tokens. The Storybook that
documents it is the next PR.

Assisted-by: Claude (Opus 5.5 Medium)

* ui: have Llama Chat use @ggml-org/llama-ui for its base components, tokens and fonts

Llama Chat kept its own copy of the design system: 29 base components, the
three tiers of tokens, the surfaces, the theme and the fonts, next to the 12
components ui/lib/ui held. The copy goes, and the library gets what it lacked.

ui/lib/ui
- the 17 base components the app had and the library did not (alert,
  alert-dialog, button-group, checkbox, collapsible, context-menu, dialog,
  drawer, dropdown-menu, empty, hover-card, radio-group, scroll-area,
  skeleton, table, tabs, textarea), with vaul-svelte for the drawer
- the inset-group and selected-row tokens and surfaces
- source
